scope: Configuration inspection only for4 publication governance tables and2 previously captured publication functions. BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; metadata SELECT only.
facts: All4 tables have relrowsecurity=true and relforcerowsecurity=false.

13 permissive policies target public role; all4 table SELECT policies require is_platform_admin(). Catalog INSERT/UPDATE include owner/admin/reviewer/editor role helper checks; QA mutations require owner/admin/reviewer; source deletion owner/admin, insert/update owner/admin/reviewer and reviewed_by=auth.uid(); review events INSERT requires is_platform_admin() and actor_id=auth.uid().

All4 table ACLs grant anon,authenticated,service_role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER plus ACL maintenance flag as captured; postgres holds owner grants. Broad table grants coexist with RLS policies; table ACL alone does not establish row access.

Both functions are SECURITY DEFINER with search_path=public. Manifest EXECUTE grantees:anon,authenticated,service_role,postgres; validate gate EXECUTE grantees:authenticated,service_role,postgres. No PUBLIC execute entry is present in either captured ACL.
Previously captured manifest definition selects only calculator_key,slug,version where lifecycle=published. Gate definition includes service_role/platform-admin guard.
limits: Genuine authorization behavior under real anon/authenticated/privileged JWT contexts was not tested. No SET ROLE, JWT impersonation, RPC/function execution, write, or source-fetch performed.
Role helper definitions and inherited role privileges were not exhaustively inspected. Configuration metadata does not certify effective access isolation.

TRUNCATE privileges are present in table grants and TRUNCATE is outside row-level policy filtering; execution reachability through application/API or other role capabilities was not tested. No remediation attempted.

FORCE RLS=false is observed; owner/bypass behavior was not exercised. Security-definer functions can execute with owner privileges; body/grants are configuration evidence rather than caller authorization test evidence.
